We are a small Australian family who doesn't allow our geographical location to define our adventures. Whether 10 mins from home or 10000 kilometres away we enjoy to travel, love, learn and to share.
Camping in tents, budget accommodation or even converting a school bus into a motorhome, we do it all and aim to share the highs, lows and any tips we pick up along the way.

We have sold our home and now  liveaboard our 42 foot Fountaine Pajot Venezia Catamaran. We will soon start sharing our sailing journey, including all the highs, the lows and the amazing adventures. 

Follow along if you would like to see our journeys.
